remarks: Welcome to 28 Caballeros Rd — a rare offering in the gated hillside enclave of Rolling Hills, where sprawling parcels, hiking and horse trails, and lush greenery set the stage for true resort-style living above the clouds. This exceptional 5,874 sq ft estate (4,727 sq ft main house plus a ~1,147 sq ft guest house) offers 5 bedrooms and 5.75 baths, fully reimagined by Kim Lapin Interiors and Canyon Homes in a modern Montecito Ranch aesthetic. Enter through a private courtyard with a running fountain into a home defined by vaulted ceilings and thoughtful flow throughout. Curated natural, vintage, and hand-crafted finishes are found at every turn — Calacatta Viola marble, terrazzo
